import pandas as pd
import sqlite3
from datetime import date, timedelta

as_of = date(2026, 6, 5)
wd = as_of.weekday()  # Monday=0
print("Today", as_of, "weekday", wd)  # 0=Mon
# This week: Monday of week containing today .. today
mon_this = as_of - timedelta(days=wd)
sun_this = mon_this + timedelta(days=6)
print("This week:", mon_this, "to", sun_this)
# Last week: entire previous week
mon_last = mon_this - timedelta(days=7)
sun_last = sun_this - timedelta(days=7)
print("Last week (tuần rồi):", mon_last, "to", sun_last)

conn = sqlite3.connect("/content/ornith_opencode_train_eval_agent_20261119_133345/eval_newharness_1795095561/_shop_roots/q_2ea34572153a/data/pos.sqlite")
df = pd.read_sql_query("""SELECT MaHoaDon, MaKhachHang, TinhTrang, TongTienHang, NgayLap
                          FROM don_hang WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', NgayLap) BETWEEN '2026-05-25' AND '2026-06-01'""", conn)
print("\nRows in week:", len(df))
print("Statuses in week:\n", df['TinhTrang'].value_counts().to_string())
print("Orders with no customer code:", df['MaKhachHang'].isna().sum())

# Revenue = sum of TongTienHang for completed + shipping
keep = df[df['TinhTrang'].isin(['completed','shipping'])]
print("\nCounting rows kept:", len(keep))
res = keep.groupby('MaKhachHang')['TongTienHang'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 10 customers by revenue:")
for i,(kh,v) in enumerate(res.head(10).items()):
    print(i, kh, v)
conn.close()

import pandas as pd
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/content/ornith_opencode_train_eval_agent_20261119_133345/eval_newharness_1795095561/_shop_roots/q_2ea34572153a/data/pos.sqlite")
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT MaHoaDon, MaKhachHang, TinhTrang, TongTienHang, NgayLap FROM don_hang", conn)
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['NgayLap'], errors='coerce')
# check unparseable
bad = df['d'].isna().sum()
print("Unparseable dates:", bad)
if bad:
    print(df[df['d'].isna()['NgayLap'].values][:10].to_string())

mon_last, sun_last = pd.Timestamp('2026-05-25'), pd.Timestamp('2026-06-01')
mask = (df['d'] >= mon_last) & (df['d'] <= sun_last)
wk = df[mask].copy()
print("\nRows in last week:", len(wk))
print("Statuses:", wk['TinhTrang'].value_counts().to_string())
print("No customer code:", wk['MaKhachHang'].isna().sum())

keep = wk[wk['TinhTrang'].isin(['completed','shipping'])]
res = keep.groupby('MaKhachHang')['TongTienHang'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 5 customers by revenue (last week):")
for i,(kh,v) in enumerate(res.head(5).items()):
    print(i, kh, v)
conn.close()
